cohort: A nationally representative Canadian cohort consisting of 130,931 singleton births from 2006, created by linking birth registration data with the 2006 long-form census.
finding: In a Canadian birth cohort, cohabiting and legally married women experienced similar birth outcomes, while most outcomes for single women were substantially worse, including higher risks for stillbirth, infant mortality, preterm birth, and small-for-gestational-age birth.
followup_time: Up to 1 year postpartum (for infant mortality outcome)
